meta.name: explainer-video-guide
meta.description: Explainer video production guide: scripting, voiceover, visuals, and assembly. Covers script formulas, pacing rules, scene planning, and multi-tool pipelines. Use for: product demos, how-it-works videos, onboarding videos, social explainers. Triggers: explainer video, how to make explainer, product video, demo video, video production, video script, animated explainer, product demo video, tutorial video, onboarding video, walkthrough video, video pipeline

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作产品演示和讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作产品讲解或演示视频
copy.tagline_en: Create product demos and explainer videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce explainer or demo videos

howto.what: Claude 会指导你从脚本、配音、画面到合成制作解释性视频，提供脚本公式、节奏规则、场景规划和多工具流水线。
howto.when: 当你提到“解释性视频”、“产品演示”、“教程视频”等关键词，或要求制作视频脚本、动画解释时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个60秒的产品解释视频脚本，用PAS公式。
say.note: Claude 会生成脚本结构并给出字数建议。

say.text: 生成一段配音文案，语速150词/分钟。
say.note: Claude 会按节奏规则输出配音文本。

say.text: 规划一个90秒的BAB结构视频场景。
say.note: Claude 会列出每个场景的时长和内容。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through scripting, voiceover, visuals, and assembly for explainer videos, covering script formulas, pacing rules, scene planning, and multi-tool pipelines.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'explainer video', 'product demo', 'tutorial video', or ask for video script or animated explainer.

say_en.text: Write a 60-second product explainer script using the PAS formula.
say_en.note: Claude will output a structured script with word counts.

say_en.text: Generate a voiceover script at 150 wpm.
say_en.note: Claude will follow pacing rules for the script.

say_en.text: Plan a 90-second BAB video scene breakdown.
say_en.note: Claude will list each scene's duration and content.
